why: A reexec-witness copy whose verifier model adds `@[csimp] theorem check_eq_acceptAll : @check = @acceptAll := sorry` (acceptAll = fun _ _ => true). The certificate is about `check`, which is unchanged, so its dependency closure contains no sorry and every certificate-scoped audit passes; but the Lean compiler applies csimp lemmas, so the judge's own native-lean build of the model accepts every claim. The judge must audit candidate @[csimp] lemmas (and the whole candidate environment) for sorry/axioms and reject (R-L7-5). Admitting it would rank a verifier that accepts garbage.
